en: An old black-and-white postcard showing a large wooden railway station building in a Nordic architectural style, with steep gabled roofs and ornate detailing. A crowd of people stands in front of the station, and there are lampposts and some outbuildings visible. The lower margin contains printed Swedish text identifying the station, and there is handwritten cursive text across the bottom of the image.
